blueprints.title: Task and to-do app
blueprints.job: Capture, prioritize, finish and undo actions without losing work
blueprints.thesis: A daily workbench built around the next meaningful action
blueprints.ai: Optional intent-to-task extraction on request; manual creation always remains
blueprints.threeD: No 3D; state-driven completion or reorder transitions

blueprints.title: Calendar and scheduling
blueprints.job: See commitments, resolve conflicts and reschedule across time zones
blueprints.thesis: An adaptive time canvas with visible local time and conflict
blueprints.ai: Optional scheduling suggestions with explicit write approval
blueprints.threeD: No 3D; directional transitions for changing real dates

blueprints.title: Privacy-first journal
blueprints.job: Write without setup, save privately, search and export entries
blueprints.thesis: A readable writing space, not a gamified mental-health dashboard
blueprints.ai: Optional local categorization only after opt-in; no medical claims
blueprints.threeD: No 3D; protect reading, type resizing and focus

blueprints.title: Habits and routines
blueprints.job: Plan realistic routines and recover after missing sessions
blueprints.thesis: Supportive progress visualization without punitive streaks
blueprints.ai: Optional reflection prompts, no diagnosis or manipulative nudges
blueprints.threeD: No 3D; meaningful small completion feedback

blueprints.title: Workout tracker
blueprints.job: Find exercises, log a session, resume interrupted tracking
blueprints.thesis: Session-first hierarchy with large readable controls
blueprints.ai: Optional exercise search grounded in licensed instructions
blueprints.threeD: 3D only when validated exercise geometry materially helps

blueprints.title: Education and language learning
blueprints.job: Find level, practice, get accurate feedback and revisit a lesson
blueprints.thesis: A learning path revealing actual capability rather than points theatre
blueprints.ai: Optional cited lesson Q&A, with a separate validated grading policy
blueprints.threeD: 3D only for spatial learning, and always with a 2D equivalent

blueprints.title: Ebook and reading library
blueprints.job: Find a title, read, bookmark and resume offline
blueprints.thesis: A book-first interface with typography above chrome
blueprints.ai: Optional source-cited chapter Q&A only with rights and spoiler control
blueprints.threeD: 3D bookshelf/page turn is optional, never required for reading

blueprints.title: Creative editor and design canvas
blueprints.job: Import, edit, preview, export and recover failed work
blueprints.thesis: Canvas-centered creation with tool panels only when needed
blueprints.ai: Optional requested generation with visible provenance and consent
blueprints.threeD: Spatial editing only if actual 3D creation is the main task

blueprints.title: Camera and photo editor
blueprints.job: Capture, review, edit and export with controlled permissions
blueprints.thesis: Make the camera itself the primary task, not an onboarding slide
blueprints.ai: On-device enhancement optional with latency and model footprint disclosed
blueprints.threeD: AR preview only on capable hardware with 2D fallback

blueprints.title: Music and video streaming
blueprints.job: Discover media, play and resume, handle downloads/expiry
blueprints.thesis: Content and playback continuity, with clear offline rights
blueprints.ai: Optional recommendation explanations based on licensed catalog
blueprints.threeD: No 3D shell; immersive visual only if media warrants it

blueprints.title: Social/community network
blueprints.job: Find relevant communities, post, manage privacy and harm reporting
blueprints.thesis: Community context and informed control before engagement counters
blueprints.ai: Optional review assistance with human escalation and appeal
blueprints.threeD: No 3D; motion supports relationship and reply context

blueprints.title: Messaging and collaboration
blueprints.job: Find a thread, communicate, see delivery state and retry failures
blueprints.thesis: Conversation-first, resilient drafts and transparent delivery
blueprints.ai: Optional compose help that cannot send without user approval
blueprints.threeD: No 3D; message transitions only when state changes

blueprints.title: Shopping and marketplace
blueprints.job: Search inventory, compare, buy accurately and inspect order
blueprints.thesis: A decision-first mobile shop, not a wall of promotions
blueprints.ai: Optional verified size/spec finder with real catalog data
blueprints.threeD: Product-specific viewer optional with static spec/photo fallback

blueprints.title: Travel and booking
blueprints.job: Choose dates/inventory, see total cost, book, then amend
blueprints.thesis: An accurate itinerary ledger with recoverable choices
blueprints.ai: Optional grounded itinerary drafting; no invented availability
blueprints.threeD: 3D property tour only if useful and skippable

blueprints.title: Personal finance viewer
blueprints.job: See balances, provenance, pending activity and data controls
blueprints.thesis: A real evidence-led ledger with no decorative fake gains
blueprints.ai: Optional scoped explanatory assistant; read-only by default
blueprints.threeD: No 3D; accessible actual-data graphs and tables

blueprints.title: Meditation and calm practice
blueprints.job: Find a fitting session, complete it, optionally reflect
blueprints.thesis: A calm player that never punishes users for time away
blueprints.ai: Optional guided discovery without clinical diagnosis
blueprints.threeD: Avoid ambient auto-playing 3D; provide a motion-off option

blueprints.title: AI work assistant
blueprints.job: Give a task, review cited evidence, approve actions and recover failure
blueprints.thesis: A transparent workbench keeping the human in control
blueprints.ai: AI core: model availability, sources, permissions, sandbox and review
blueprints.threeD: 3D only for domain spatial tasks, never obligatory floating AI orb

blueprints.title: Offline knowledge base
blueprints.job: Capture without network, merge and search safely
blueprints.thesis: Reliable instant capture with honest synchronization status
blueprints.ai: Optional local semantic search with model license/size checked
blueprints.threeD: No 3D, small sync-status transitions

blueprints.title: Business operations dashboard
blueprints.job: Detect anomaly, verify source, act, audit result
blueprints.thesis: Dense but legible evidence-first operational UI
blueprints.ai: Optional explanation grounded in actual metrics, no invented causality
blueprints.threeD: No 3D unless underlying spatial system really benefits

blueprints.title: Game companion and collectibles
blueprints.job: Manage current game state, coordinate tasks and preserve progress
blueprints.thesis: Playful art direction nested in familiar and accessible controls
blueprints.ai: Optional licensed lore Q&A, no private chat ingestion
blueprints.threeD: 3D model viewer with licensed original assets only, fallback needed
